The '''Artisan Arrivals Court''' was a plaza in the [[Blastfield Shipyards]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]. The [[Shipwright Auxiliary Spaceport]] and the [[Socorro Freight building]] were located on the Court.
